messages:
maya: quick heads-up — canary run on harrier-int4 showed a 6.8% spike in funcall JSON parse failures vs harrier-fp16 baseline over last 6h
liam: ouch. any obvious diff in tokenization or suffix patterns? :thinking:
maya: aggregated suffixes show trailing comma + stray backslash combos, e.g. `{\"action\": \"open\", \"args\": [1,2,], \\n}` — looks like truncation + quant noise
sophia: that fits prior int4 suffix-noise trends. quantized attention sometimes clips tokens at EOS boundary leaving partial escapes
oliver: can we confirm model output vs proxy encoding? canary raw dump?
maya: grabbed raw from 12 samples — excerpts:
```
{\"tool\":\"create_ticket\",\"payload\": {\"title\": \"Crash on iOS 17\", \"priority\": \"hi\",},

{\"tool\":\"search\",\"q\": \"customer id: 123\\\\n\"
```
liam: yep, truncated escape and trailing comma. likely model-side
canary-bot: canary harrier-int4 v2026-03-20T10:30 run summary: parse_fail_rate=0.068, mean_latency=220ms, fallback-to-fp16=0.002
maya: proposal: prioritized retry flow to avoid full-model re-invokes for cheap fixes
sophia: sketch?
maya: 3-stage retry (funcall_retry_strategy_v3):
  1) lint-and-lightfix — local deterministic: strip trailing commas, close simple unbalanced braces, normalize lone backslashes to escaped \" in strings
  2) tolerant-json-parse mode — permissive parser that accepts single quotes/unquoted keys and rehydrates trailing commas
  3) if still failing AND model_variant == \"quant_int4\" AND retry_budget_remaining > 0 -> mirror-retry to fp16 shadow (single-shot)
oliver: concerns: (a) deterministic fixes might mask true truncation (semantic loss), (b) mirror-retry doubles cost for that request
liam: mitigate: only run lightfix for short outputs (token_count < 200) and only mirror-retry if schema_prob > 0.6
qa-runner: I\'ll run AB test matrix: control, lightfix-only, lightfix+tolerant, full-flow. 1% traffic each initially
sophia: add telemetry tags: parse_fail_cause in {trailing_comma, broken_escape, truncation, other} and postfix_action in {fixed, tolerant_parsed, mirror_retried}
maya: desired log example:
```
parse_event: {\"ts\": 1746144445, \"model\":\"harrier-int4\", \"suffix_len\": 34, \"parse_fail_cause\":\"broken_escape\", \"action\":\"lightfix_applied\"}
```
liam: rollout CLI snippet:
```
redwood deploy-config set funcall_retry_strategy_v3 --param \"lightfix_token_limit=200\" --param \"schema_prob_threshold=0.6\" --percent=1
```
oliver: implementation note: keep lightfix regex+small AST balancer only. LM-based repair is a different opt-in path
sophia: also ensure streaming assembly runs fix on final concatenated payload; streaming mid-chunk noise is a thing
maya: QA checklist:
  - 24h canary with 2k probe prompts across canonical schemas
  - measure false-positive acceptance (cases where lightfix returns semantically wrong but parsable JSON)
  - latency p50/p95 delta for requests hitting lightfix
qa-runner: kicking off runs now. will post 6h interim graphs to #eng-ml
liam: if >80% of failures fixed by step1/2 keep mirror-retry off to save cost
sophia: docs suggestion: recommend sentinel field \"__end__\": true in tool schemas where feasible
maya: tagging @oliver for parser review and @qa-runner for execution
canary-bot: scheduled: funcall_retry_strategy_v3 rollout -> lightfix_only(1%), mixed_flow(1%), control(98%). first metrics in ~6h
